checkScope: Installed desktop package contracts for tools.register, subprocess.spawn, Windows CreateProcessW, workingDirectory.ensure, and llm.registerAdapter. Model discovery uses tr codex debug models, tr grok models, and Codex app-server model/list. Not a live plugin-load, model-menu, model-reply, or in-app tool-call test.
